newsitem.title: USA: Urethane Tech says future is "endangered".
newsitem.headline: Urethane Tech says future is "endangered".

text.p: Urethane Technologies Inc on Friday said Endeavour Capital Corp has terminated an agreement to inject up to $1.65 million in Urethane Technologies, leaving the company's future in jeopardy.

"The funding promised by Endeavour Capital would have furnished critical assistance in our effort to turn the business around, grow and develop. Without it, (Urethane Technology's) future is endangered," Chief Executive Officer James Orefice said in a statement.

On Tuesday, Urethane said Endeavour would invest the funds for preferred stock that was convertible into 80 percent of Urethane's common stock, effectively giving the Endeavour group voting control of Urethane.
Urethane said it had been in discussions with another firm about funding possibilities, but those talks ceased when it reached its agreeement with Endeavour.
"We will attempt to revive these discussions, but there is no assurance that we will be successful," Orefice said.
Specialty chemical maker Urethane produces proprietary polyurethane products that are used in construction, recreation, autos and other markets.
In November, the company reported a third quarter loss of $0.25 a share versus a loss of $0.03 a share one year earlier.

When it announced the initial deal with Endeavour this week, it said the last 12 months had been "extremely difficult" with a squeeze in operating margins and increased competition and raw materials prices.
Company executives were immediately unavailable to comment further.
